facts.text: In 1848, the Galena and Chicago Union Railroad was granted three miles of right‑of‑way, and the depot that opened there was named Wheaton.
The historic Grand Theater, built in 1925, reopened in 2002 and was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2005.
Wheaton College, founded on land donated by a local benefactor, has been a community fixture for nearly 150 years.
The city’s former county courthouse, now a National Register site, once housed National Louis University until the school relocated to Lisle in 2004.
In 1868, a group of Wheaton Civil War veterans staged the “Midnight Raid” on Naperville’s courthouse to retrieve county records that had been withheld.
